title: Connecting patient support, healthcare marketing, and analytics.
text:
ABOUT



I’m Mariam El Jouzou, a marketing professional working in the healthcare and pharmaceutical space, with a focus on patient support initiatives.
My current work has given me the opportunity to support complex, cross-functional programs designed to improve the patient experience across the treatment journey. I work closely with cross-functional teams to help bring patient-facing communications and support resources to life.
Before moving into healthcare and pharmaceutical marketing, my background was rooted in eCommerce and digital marketing, where I worked across content strategy, SEO, Amazon advertising, digital shelf optimization, and performance-driven growth.
That combination of experiences shaped the direction I want to continue building toward: using analytics to strengthen how we understand patients, customers, markets, and business performance.



I chose Applied Business Analytics because I believe in the power of data to make strategy more informed and marketing more meaningful.
In healthcare and patient support, decisions are rarely isolated. They involve understanding behavior, identifying barriers, evaluating engagement, and determining where communication or support can create the most value.
I want to build the analytical skills that allow me to connect those business and patient questions with data — not only to understand what is happening, but also why it is happening, what it means, and what we should do next.






＋


Supporting patient-facing initiatives across healthcare and pharmaceutical programs.



◇


Translating complex needs across clients, teams, and stakeholders into clear execution.



⌁


Building skills in Python, SQL, PySpark, cloud analytics, machine learning, and statistical analysis.






I’m especially interested in the intersection of patient experience, pharmaceutical marketing, and analytics.
For me, the value of analytics is not simply in producing an output. It is in using evidence to ask better questions, understand people more clearly, and support smarter decisions.




Senior Account Executive
Healthcare & Pharmaceutical Marketing · Patient Support
MS Applied Business Analytics Candidate
Boston University
